changes.reason: The extra dim doubles the ledger render dim electric light, so one goes.

changes.find: The parents had gathered around the {t:table}
changes.reason: The Japanese 親子 gathers parent and child together, not parents alone.
changes.replace: Parent and child had gathered around the {t:table}

changes.find: had yet a single wrinkle in the face.
changes.reason: English puts wrinkles on faces, and number is not meaningful in the Japanese.
changes.replace: had yet a single wrinkle on their faces.

changes.find: they poured their eyes upon all that was the child.
changes.reason: The Japanese is ordinary tender looking, which poured turns grotesque in English.
changes.replace: they fixed their eyes upon all that was the child.

changes.find: with a face full of smile pinched the round jutting cheek lightly with his fingers,
changes.reason: As it stands the face does the pinching, so the actor and pause are restored.
changes.replace: with a face full of smile, he pinched the round jutting cheek lightly with his fingers,

changes.find: And in the cluttering noisiness they did not hear the sound of the wind and rain.
changes.reason: The Japanese is noisy clatter that drowns the storm, not clutter as mess.
changes.replace: And in the clattering bustle they did not hear the sound of the wind and rain.

changes.find: In the gap he opened a large mouth hastily, and pushed rice into his own mouth.
changes.reason: He opens his mouth wide in haste, not a detached large mouth, and nothing grotesque is intended.
changes.replace: In the gap he hastily opened his mouth wide and pushed rice into his own mouth.

changes.find: The far picture lay dark and silent at the bottom of her eyes.
changes.reason: 映ってゐた is being reflected, and that reflection is the vision's mechanism.
changes.replace: The far picture was reflected dark and silent at the bottom of her eyes.

changes.find: And yet we have been through a lot, haven't we.
changes.reason: 苦労 is toil and married-poverty hardship, which been through a lot generalizes away.
changes.replace: And yet we have known a good deal of hardship, haven't we.

changes.find: though day by day we are tired and worried and made to suffer by all sorts of things,
changes.reason: The Japanese thinks in three parallel passives, which two states plus one passive breaks.
changes.replace: though day by day we are made tired, made anxious, made to suffer by all sorts of things,

changes.find: The man, as if with nothing to do with his hands, looked at the child standing holding the spoon.
changes.reason: 手持ぶさた is the set-phrase for idle embarrassment, which word-for-word English cannot carry.
changes.replace: The man, as if at a loose end, looked at the child standing holding the spoon.

declined.reason: Stet: the reading requires flavourless, unconnected, cold badness to stay oddly exact as the physical ground of the vision.

data.say: Repaired grammar and idiom, restored parent-and-child, reflection, hardship and parallelism, and kept unconnected per the crux.
